emergency.title: Please get care right away
emergency.body: Chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting or confusion need emergency care. Call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room. An IV at home is not the right care for this.

talk.title: Let's talk before you book
talk.body: What you picked means Deanna should talk with you first so she can make sure an IV is safe for you and choose the right one. She's a registered nurse with more than 20 years of ICU experience. Text or call and she'll walk you through it.
talk.smsText: Hi Deanna, I used the Help Me Choose quiz on your site. Before I book, can we talk about what's safe for me?
